items.value: Oh, Murat, my son! How I missed you! You were gone for so long!
Mother, we need to talk.
Oh, of course, of course, should I pour you some tea?
No, the conversation will be serious.
Ahem... Alixander, my dear, I'll conjure up some soap bubbles for you in the yard now, go play with them.
I need something to pop the bubbles... oh! The scarecrow has my slingshot!
Almost there, princess, but I need to get my weapon!
Oh, I understand, my squire! Forward to victory!
Here, take it!
So you!
Right on target!
Oh, the mirror broke, and a magical one at that, that's bad luck... It was an accident! It's not my fault! It... no, I need to tell grandma, I'm not a liar, I'm an honest knight!
Grandma is in the house, talking to dad!
Grandma couldn’t have run away from the house, she’s probably still there!
It's so embarrassing... but I have to confess to grandma! She should be in the house.
How can you? How can you, you heartless one? He misses you! And you mean to tell me he'll never see you again?!
My duty to the Kingdom comes first. Even to him.
I didn't raise you that way! You're a good boy, understand that Alixander misses you! He needs you!
I already said that my duty...
No! Your duty is to the lich! You're his father! Understand, you idiot, that you can't just up and abandon your own son!
My new position won't allow me to leave the Capital for long periods. And I won't be able to receive visitors for security reasons.
Don't make excuses! You're stronger than any spy, what security?! You just don't want to see him! You want him to grow up an orphan too, huh?!
He will have you
So what? He needs a full-fledged family, not just me! How can you?!
I think it's best not to distract them now. I'll go play by the river!
Oh, brave lady of the lake, what an honor!
Oh, brave squire Alixander! I give you this magnificent sword! Take it and smite all evil you see!
Thank you, princess.
Please. Quack.
Oh, brave squire Alixander, help me!
Oh no, the princess is in trouble! We must save her!
Oh no, princess, we're surrounded by evil monsters! Nettlebush!
Yes, Alixander! Beat them!
Yes, princess! Sooooo good!
H-here! Stupid bush!
Take that! I'm the strongest!
Attack! Break through!
Phew! That was a tough fight!
That's right, Alixander! You're great! You handled it all!
Thank you, princess!
